mcq_fix.s: Arrange the following developments in the Madras Presidency in chronological order: A. The Madras High Court replaced the Company courts. B. The Indian Penal Code was enacted. C. The Code of Criminal Procedure was enacted. D. The Queen's Proclamation was issued.
mcq_fix.why: IPC (1860) came into force only on 1 Jan 1862, after CrPC 1861, so 'came into force' breaks keyed order D,B,C,A; 'enacted' makes key correct

mcq_drop.why: obscure trivia (Peshwa Rao conspiracy year) far beyond PYQ depth

patterns: APPSC asks Bobbili directly: year 1757 and that Vijayarama Raju took French help; Padmanabham = English vs Vizianagaram zamindars.
1857 in Hyderabad: Turrebaz Khan led the Residency attack; Nizam of 1857 = Afzal-ud-Daula; chronology Mubariz-ud-Daula -> Aurangabad -> Residency attack.
Assertion-reason on Andhra's limited response: 'no local leaders' is false, Nizam pro-British true (key 4).
App MCQs go far deeper than PYQs (officer names, dates of Uyyalawada's capture, informers, pensions) - mostly multi-statement items on minute details.
